title: 第810章 青屿城暂留第809章 紧急离去
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
三人极力赶路，很快步入了南海王国的地盘，人口越来越密集起来。南海王国与雪山王国相反，雪山王国是地广人稀，而南海王国是国土偏小，但是人口很多。
无论是气候、资源，还是交通，南海王国都要更好一些。孙云三人进入南海王国，就像沙入了大海，显得微不足道，这里人口实在是太密集了。当然，主要是他们三人隐藏了八阶实力，看起来就和普通修士一样。
“师傅，你们来了！”
青屿城一处别院里，负责接应的人员，正是子墨等人。
对于孙云的任务，鬼老三派人通知了火狐媚儿，火狐媚儿很快派来了协助人员。由于人员吃紧，只抽调了毒女丽娜、孙云的徒弟子墨、还有巨人阿呆三人。
“嗯，有北野文的消息吗？”
孙云点点头，直接切入主题。
北野文逃走有一段时间，孙云才刚刚到，自然要了解一下情况。北野文之所以这么做，肯定是早有计划了，不是那么容易就能抓到的。
像北野文这种事情，也是可以理解的，不是没有发生过类似事件。他弟弟北野武算计孙云不成，北野文压制孙云又不成，已经成为了笑柄，学院也不可能重视他了。而且，孙云最近得势，以后必然找北野文算账。
所以，北野文选择铤而走险，出卖个人人格，去拼一把灵器持有权。
“茫茫人海，北野文只要不出现，是很难找到的。北野文的家乡，在一处巨大的岛屿上，那里属于独立的小国家，不属于南海王国管辖。北野家在那空魔岛上，影响力非常大，不太好过去探查！”子墨赶紧汇报道。
子墨虽然年龄小，但对于探查信息这一块，还是比较上心的，深得鬼手的真传。这南海王国，子墨以前没有来过，人员又比较密集，探查难度很大。
“嗯，你这次来就不要走了，赶去南海学院报名吧！师傅领进门，修行在个人，你底子已经算可以了，要找好自己的修行路线了！”孙云点点头，直接吩咐道。
南海学院，对水系和风系也是颇为擅长的，让子墨在这里学习倒是挺不错的。子墨擅长风系魔法，主修刺客，进入南海学院学习不是问题。
至于巴桑，性格太过于野蛮，孙云打算让他在灵脉学院学习了。有琴皇子在林脉王国照顾，就算是巴桑惹点事，琴皇子也会帮忙解决的。
“是，我们现在就出发！”
子墨一直对孙云言听计从，直接带着巨人阿呆离去了。
阿呆虽然智商有问题，但实力倒是不弱，已经是七阶后期高手了。阿呆的战斗本能很强，而且有体格上的优势，一般七阶高手不是他的对手。
所以，有阿呆保护子墨，只要子墨不过于张扬，应该没有什么问题的。确实不是没有更强的人选，只是过多的保护不太利于子墨历练，会影响他的成长。
“丽娜，去联系一下，我们出海去空魔岛旅游吧！”紧接着，孙云吩咐丽娜一声。

知己知彼，才能百战百胜，所以孙云打算先去北野文得老巢看看。毕竟，想要干掉北野文，也要提前想好自己的退路，不能太过于冲动了。
“好的，我马上去安排！”
丽娜点点头，出去定制船票了。
丽娜经验丰富，而且性格冷静果断，深得孙云的信任。所以，不是媚儿刻意派丽娜来，而是丽娜的能力确实有目共睹，更加懂得自己的位置，能更好地配合孙云。
虽然，孙云实力不弱了，但面对茫茫大海，他还是非常渺小的。大海是无边无际的，比这片大陆大太多倍了，海中的魔兽更是数不胜数，所以必须借助专门的船只出行才有保障。
“胖子，你去市场招收几个人，就以商人身份留在这里吧！胡老，这段时间你先协助何胖子，你俩凡事都要低调点，先落下脚再说！”紧接着，孙云继续吩咐道。
去空魔岛，相当于入虎穴，自然要保持低调了。何胖子体型太胖，行事太招眼了，不适合隐藏。胡老的岁数不小了，确实也经不住折腾，所以孙云让他俩留在这里接应。
而且，孙云在雪山王国获得的东西，已经被分身孙森带人整理好了，也该想办法处理变现了。
“我不，我要跟你一起去！”
何胖子显然不情愿，不愿意离开孙云。
何胖子这次，属于私自过来的，不算是参加任务的人。何胖子不喜欢闷着修炼，更喜欢到处乱跑，尤其是跟在孙云身边，总能遇到更刺激的事情。
“胖子，你不能一直跟着我，也该自己独立了。这青屿城，很有可能有北野文的踪迹，你必须留下探查情况。我这批物品，你看着处理就好了，获得的金币你俩尽管用，只要不刻意浪费就好了。你们也可以成立势力，用这些做启动资金，想怎么折腾怎么折腾，放手去做吧！”孙云为了说服何胖子，可下了血本了。
当然，对于自己人，孙云一向是比较大方的。何胖子也跟了孙云很多年了，帮孙云做了不少事了，只是性格太过于懒散了，孙云不好给何胖子明确定位。
“那行吧，你们早点回来，不然我也会过去的！”何胖子点点头，出言叮嘱道。
去不去空魔岛，对于何胖子来说意义不大，反正都是陌生的地方。只是，空魔岛是北野文的地盘，何胖子担心孙云的安全。
“放心吧，我心里有数，会做到凡事忍三忍的！你们两个出去一趟，帮我购置一些必备品，我要先休息调整一下！”孙云点点头，有些困乏的说道。
一直忙着赶路，孙云还没有好好休息过，这会他打算补一觉。不是孙云矫情，他最近确实太忙了，需要调整一下自己的状态，才能做到少失误。
“好的，那我们去了！”
何胖子和胡老应声出去帮忙采购了。何胖子虽然懒散，但能力还是可以的，加上胡老的辅助，基本没有什么问题！
“大海，我很期待！”

孙云念叨了一句，赶紧躺下休息了。任何人，都对大海有一丝向往，孙云自然也不例外。
content_en:
The three of them hurried on their way and soon entered the territory of the South China Sea Kingdom, where the population became increasingly dense. The South China Sea Kingdom is the opposite of the Snow Mountain Kingdom. The Snow Mountain Kingdom is vast and sparsely populated, while the South China Sea Kingdom is small but has a large population.
Whether it is climate, resources, or transportation, the South China Sea Kingdom is better. When Sun Yun and the other three entered the Nanhai Kingdom, they were like sand entering the sea. They seemed insignificant. The population here was too dense. Of course, the main reason is that the three of them hide their eighth-level strength and look just like ordinary monks.
"Master, you are here!"
In a separate courtyard in Lantau City, the person responsible for the reception was none other than Zimo and others.
Regarding Sun Yun's mission, Gui Laosan sent someone to notify Huohu Meier, and Huohu Meier quickly sent assistance. Due to the shortage of personnel, only the poisonous girl Lina, Sun Yun's disciple Zi Mo, and the giant Dumb were recruited.
"Well, is there any news about Kitano Fumi?"
Sun Yun nodded and got to the point directly.
Bei Yewen had been running away for a while, and Sun Yun had just arrived, so he naturally wanted to know the situation. The reason why Kitano Fumi did this must have been planned in advance, and it was not easy to catch.
Things like Kitano Fumi are understandable. It’s not that similar incidents have never happened. His younger brother Kitano Takeshi failed to plot Sun Yun, and Kitano Fumi failed to suppress Sun Yun. He has become a laughing stock, and it is impossible for the academy to take him seriously. Moreover, Sun Yun has gained power recently and will definitely settle the score with Kitano Wen in the future.
Therefore, Kitano Wen chose to take a desperate risk and betray his personality to fight for the right to possess the spiritual weapon.
"In the vast sea of ​​people, it is difficult to find Kitano Wen unless he appears. Kitano Wen's hometown is on a huge island. It is a small independent country and is not under the jurisdiction of the South China Sea Kingdom. The Kitano family has a very large influence on Nakon Demon Island, so it is not easy to go there to explore!" Zimo quickly reported.
Although Zimo is young, he is still quite concerned about detecting information, and he has won the true inheritance of Gui Shou. Zimo had never been to this South China Sea Kingdom before, and the people there were relatively dense, so it was very difficult to explore.
"Well, don't leave this time. Go to Nanhai College to register! The master will lead you in. Cultivation is personal. You are already good at it. You have to find your own practice route!" Sun Yun nodded and gave instructions directly.
Nanhai Academy is also quite good at water and wind elements, so it would be good for Zimo to study here. Zimo is good at wind magic and majors in assassin. It is not a problem to study in Nanhai Academy.
As for Basang, his character was too barbaric, so Sun Yun planned to let him study at the Spiritual Pulse Academy. With Prince Qin taking care of him in the Linmai Kingdom, even if Basang causes trouble, Prince Qin will help solve it.
"Yes, let's leave now!"
Zimo always obeyed Sun Yunyan and left directly with the giant Dumb.
Although Dumb has a problem with his IQ, his strength is not weak and he is already a master of the late seventh level. Dui's fighting instinct is very strong, and he has a physical advantage. Generally, seventh-level masters are no match for him.
Therefore, with Dui protecting Zimo, as long as Zimo doesn't show off too much, there should be no problem. It's true that there are no stronger candidates, but too much protection is not conducive to Zimo's experience and will affect his growth.
"Lina, let's get in touch. Let's go to the Sky Demon Island to travel!" Immediately afterwards, Sun Yun ordered Lina.
Only by knowing oneself and the enemy can one be victorious in every battle, so Sun Yun planned to visit Kitano Wende's lair first. After all, if you want to kill Kitano Wen, you have to think about your retreat in advance and don't be too impulsive.
"Okay, I'll make arrangements right away!"
Lina nodded and went out to customize the ship ticket.
Lina has rich experience and a calm and decisive personality, winning Sun Yun's trust. Therefore, it is not that Meier sent Lina here deliberately, but that Lina's ability is indeed obvious to all, and she understands her position better and can betterCooperate with Sun Yun.
Although Sun Yun is no longer weak, he is still very small in the face of the vast sea. The sea is boundless, many times larger than this continent, and there are countless monsters in the sea, so special ships must be used to travel safely.
"Fat man, you go to the market to recruit a few people, and then stay here as a businessman! Mr. Hu, during this time, you will assist Fatty He first. You two must keep a low profile in everything, and settle down first!" Immediately afterwards, Sun Yun continued to give instructions.
Going to Sky Demon Island is equivalent to entering the tiger's den, so naturally you have to keep a low profile. Fatty He is too fat and his behavior is too conspicuous to hide. Mr. Hu was already quite old and he really couldn't bear the torment, so Sun Yun asked them to stay here to take care of him.
Moreover, the things Sun Yun obtained in the Snow Mountain Kingdom have been sorted out by the clone Sun Sen, and it is time to find a way to cash them in.
"No, I want to go with you!"
Fatty He was obviously reluctant to leave Sun Yun.
Fatty He came here privately this time and was not considered a participant in the mission. Fatty He didn't like to practice in silence, and preferred to run around, especially when he was with Sun Yun, he would always encounter more exciting things.
"Fat man, you can't follow me all the time. It's time to be independent. There are probably traces of Bei Yewen in Lantau City. You must stay and investigate. Just watch and deal with my batch of items. You can use the gold coins you get, as long as you don't deliberately waste them. You can also set up a force and use these as start-up funds. You can do whatever you want, just go ahead and do it!" Sun Yun spent a lot of money to convince Fatty He.
Of course, Sun Yun has always been more generous to his own people. Fatty He has been following Sun Yun for many years and has helped Sun Yun do a lot of things. However, his personality is too lazy and it is difficult for Sun Yun to clearly define his position for Fatty He.
"Okay, come back early, otherwise I will go there too!" Fatty He nodded and warned.
Whether to go to Kong Mo Island or not didn't mean much to Fatty He. They were all unfamiliar places anyway. However, Kong Mo Island is Bei Yewen's territory, and Fatty He is worried about Sun Yun's safety.
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing and I'll be patient with everything! You two go out and help me buy some necessary items. I need to rest and adjust first!" Sun Yun nodded and said a little sleepily.
Sun Yun has not had a good rest since he has been busy on the road, and he plans to catch up on his sleep now. It's not that Sun Yun is being pretentious. He has indeed been too busy recently and needs to adjust his state to make fewer mistakes.
"Okay, let's go then!"
Fatty He and Mr. Hu responded and went out to help with the purchase. Although Fatty He is lazy, his ability is still good. With Mr. Hu's assistance, there is basically no problem!
"The sea, I'm looking forward to it!"
Sun Yun muttered something and quickly lay down to rest. Everyone has a yearning for the sea, and Sun Yun is no exception.
